place.title: Bloodsplatter Isle
place.summary: The island houses a Barrelchest Mk II-making factory, manned by Mi-Gor. During A Clockwork Syringe, Murphy attempted to assassinate a pirate-allied adventurer in their house by sending a barrelchest there, but they survived and, with the help of captain Bill Teach, forced the leftover zombie head to tell its origins, which the head revealed to be Bloodsplatter Isle. The trio set sail on The Adventurous but were attacked by barrelchests from the island, making them unable to come ashore. The adventurer was henceforth shot onto the island using a cannonball barrel-boat fashioned from materials on the ship. With the help of the seagull Baron von Hattenkrapper, the barrelchests were eliminated and the Adventerous could safely approach.

ml.text: Sagittares are members of the Sagittare Archers of Bilrach's army, and are boss monsters in Daemonheim requiring 45 Dungeoneering. They are found on floors 23–29 of Daemonheim. They use ranged and magic, with teleporting ability, arrow rain, and multi shot. Sagittares always has Protect from Missiles on preventing 100% of Ranged damage.

place.title: Daemonheim
place.summary: Most of Daemonheim's history is told through the Chronicles of Bilrach, which are discovered as a player trains the Dungeoneering skill. place.title: Yanille Agility dungeon
place.summary: The experience rewards for using this dungeon are not as good as most other Agility courses, so players rarely come here to train Agility. Instead, players use it to training combat skills using the monsters there and gather their drops. Players training Herblore also use the dungeon, since many monsters here sometimes drop high-level herbs. Torstol, a fairly rare herb, can be obtained here.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Players must go to the Yanille area to reach the dungeon. Other than walking, there are a few ways to get there:
• The Watchtower Teleport to the Watchtower, which is quite close to the dungeon's northern entrance. This teleport ability is a reward of the Watchtower quest.
• The House Teleport to Yanille, if the player has a house and has located it in Yanille.
• The Ring of duelling teleport to Castle Wars, which is west of Yanille.
• Fairy ring code CIQ, which arrives north-west of Yanille. Partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings.
• Teleport using the Ardougne Cape 1 to the Monastery to the north of Yanille.
• Teleport using the Home teleport to the Yanille Lodestone to the west of Yanille.
• Modifying a Teleport to House tablet, so it will let you teleport to the Yanille House Portal.

getting_there.heading: Dungeon entrances
getting_there.text:
The dungeon has two entrances:
• The northern entrance is a small house north of the Yanille city walls. It is very close to the shortcut under the wall by the farming patch. Spider webs block the entrance to the house. Players must cut through a web before they can enter the house using a knife from their tool belt.
• The southern entrance is a house in south-east Yanille, west of the smithy with the anvils. Players can access this house and its basement, but the door connecting the basement to the rest of the dungeon is locked. To pick the lock and open the door, players must have a lockpick in their inventory and must have a Thieving level of at least 82.

place.title: Sophanem Slayer Dungeon
place.summary: Upon attempting to enter the dungeon, players will receive a warning if they do not have any Feathers of Ma'at on them, or if they do not meet the Slayer level requirements to kill the monsters.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is accessed via the dungeon entrance south of the temple of Icthlarin. It can be easily reached through the following methods:
• The fastest method is to use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet. The ability to craft them is gained upon reaching rank 4 with any of the Menaphos factions.
• Leela's favour provides unlimited teleports to the dungeon entrance.
• The Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) can provide two free teleports to the entrance each day, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
• Use the Menaphos lodestone, go through the gate connecting the two cities, and run south-east. Using this method requires completion of Contact!.
• Teleport to the Luminous wisp colony south of Sophanem via the full Elder divination outfit or a skill portal in the Max garden and head north.
• Teleport to the Pyramid Plunder entrance in north Sophanem via the full Master camouflage outfit and head south.
• Take a magic carpet flight to Sophanem. Upon arrival, run south and the enter the gate.
• There are several access points to the magic carpet network, including:
• Shantay Pass to southern Pollnivneach to Sophanem
• Ring of slaying or the Slayer cape perk to Sumona in Pollnivneach and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.
• Pollnivneach tablet and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.

place.title: Al Kharid
place.summary: In the past, Al Kharid was ruled by the Emir Shah, although the vast majority of the work had been taken over by Chancellor Hassan since the Emir's son was kidnapped in Stolen Hearts. After his rescue, the prince Ali Mirza became the current Emir of Al Kharid. The city is independent from both Misthalin, or any government in the Kharidian desert. Al Kharid was built in the early Fifth Age, by settlers from outside the desert. The dominant religion of Al Kharid is the Menaphite Pantheon with most citizens worshipping Het.

• Home Teleport to Lumbridge lodestone and run east through the bridge and the opening in the rocks.
• From the Lumbridge Swamp, the docks with the ship to Daemonheim give easy access to Al Kharid.
• From Daemonheim using the Ring of kinship and finally, sail off Daemonheim to the Al Kharid jetty.

Members only
• Members who have completed The Grand Tree quest can use the gnome glider to travel to and from Al Kharid.
• A Ring of duelling can teleport the player to Het's Oasis, just north-east of Al Kharid.
• An Amulet of glory can teleport the player to the Shantay Pass, right outside the south gate of Al Kharid.
• Via the one-way fairy ring from the Zanaris market area.
• From the desert to the south via the Shantay Pass.
• Use the level 8 Agility shortcut to get to and from Lumbridge swamp.
• Members who have completed Swept Away and have had their broomstick enchanted by the Sorceress' Apprentice can come via the Sorceress's Garden.
• Use the Abyss to teleport to the Fire Altar and then head south.

place.title: Moonsylvar Wood
place.summary: Moonsylvar Wood is a large forest on Havenhythe, located south of the village of Amberfell. The forest can be entered from the north by following the path south from the ruined village of Berylbrook, or from the east by following the path west out of the bogs of Fenmoor. The players may quick-travel through the forest by selecting the option on either entrance. This requires partial completion of the quest Heralds of Crimson, whereas the Sanguine Glade and Sanguine Bear Cave (as well their respective creatures) require full completion of this quest - discovering any special location in the woods before the quest is completed requires that the player returns to the entrance.

• Heathervein Key press | 5 , head south through Berylbrook.
• Linbog Village Key press | 6 , head west of Fenmoor.
• Fairy ring code DLP to Amberfell, head south-east past Berylbrook.
• Fairy ring code DIQ and head west (must first be repaired with 5 bogwart and requires level 79 Agility).
• Teleport to the fox mural via the stonevein amulet (requires partially restoring the colossi murals), then head northwest to the Fenmoor entrance.
• Travel to the Moonrise Dig Site, walk south-east through Amberfell and past Berylbrook.

• # Head south-east past Berylbrook.

The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dangerous dungeon where armies of various gods, left over from the God Wars, fight one another to the death. Its release was announced in the Behind the Scenes of August 2007.
place.teleport: God Wars Dungeon Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Prerequisites
• Navigating towards the dungeon requires having defeated Dad in the Troll Stronghold quest
• Entering the dungeon itself requires 60 Strength Boostable or 60 Agility Boostable 
• Entering each god encampment (therefore the boss rooms) has a skill requirement:
• Armadyl's Eyrie (south-west) - 70 Ranged Boostable | n 
• Bandos's Stronghold (north-west) - 70 Strength Boostable | n 
• Saradomin's Encampment (south-east) - 70 Agility Boostable | n 
• Zamorak's Fortress (north) - 70 Constitution Boostable | n 

Teleports
• Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing any generals at least once and access to War's Retreat, and at least 100 total boss kills
• Combat portal at Max Guild - Requires Max Cape achievement and killing any generals at least once
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport - Requires level 61 Magic and completion of The Mighty Fall
• God wars teleport tablet - Requires completion of The Mighty Fall
• Trollheim Teleport - Standard spells, requires level 61 Magic and completion of Eadgar's Ruse
• Trollheim tablet - Requires completed Love Story and taken the miner's diary to the Wise Old Man
• Trollheim Farm Teleport - Lunar spells, requires level 92 Magic, completion of My Arm's Big Adventure, and unlock at Livid Farm rewards

Travelling from Fremennik Province

ml.name: Treasure Trails
ml.text: Saradomin wizards are monsters that are encountered whilst doing hard clue coordinate Treasure Trails. They only appear for clues that are located outside of the Wilderness. They call out "For Saradomin!" upon appearing and attacking. They primarily attack with a combination of Air Wave and Saradomin Strike, and carry a poisoned dragon dagger as a sidearm. You can bypass the fight altogether by using Meerkats and Meerkat scroll (Fetch Casket)s.

place.title: Treasure Trails
place.summary: There are five difficulties of clue scrolls: easy, medium, hard, elite, and master. Only one of each type of sealed clue scroll can be open at a time. Opening a sealed clue scroll if a player already owns an open one isn't possible.

ml.name: Wilderness
ml.text: Saradomin wizards are monsters that are encountered whilst doing hard clue coordinate Treasure Trails. They only appear for clues that are located outside of the Wilderness. They call out "For Saradomin!" upon appearing and attacking. They primarily attack with a combination of Air Wave and Saradomin Strike, and carry a poisoned dragon dagger as a sidearm. You can bypass the fight altogether by using Meerkats and Meerkat scroll (Fetch Casket)s.
pics: Four types of abyssal demons roam around the obelisk and the north entrance of Forinthry Dungeon.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

ml.name: Shattered Worlds
ml.text: False Saradominist champions may be seen in Shattered Worlds.

place.title: Shattered Worlds
place.summary: Shattered Worlds is a combat-oriented members-only minigame in which players fight through mobs of various monsters while progressing through worlds of increasing difficulty in the Abyss. It is a solo minigame with safe death hosted by the Abyssal Knights in the north-east of the Void Knights' Outpost, who aim to protect Gielinor from potential invasions from the Abyss. Playing Shattered Worlds earns shattered anima, reward currency that can be used at the Shattered Worlds Reward Shop. A minimum combat level of 40 is recommended to participate.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Map | x=2678 | y=2679 | mtype=square | zoom=2 | align=right | caption=Shattered Worlds lobby within the Void Knight Outpost 
The entrance to Shattered Worlds is found in the north-east corner of the Void Knights' Outpost. It can be accessed by:
• Shattered Worlds teleport scroll (purchased from the reward shop) goes directly to the minigame.
• Speak to the Squire on the second southernmost pier at Port Sarim (the one north of the Charter ship) to travel to the island by ship free of charge.
• Use the teleport option of a Void knight seal.
• Use a Call to Arms scroll, with a summoned Void ravager, Void shifter, Void torcher or a Void spinner.

ml.text: location: Lumbridge Crater

place.title: Lumbridge Crater
place.summary: In the following years the crater was used as a site of many events, most notably hosting The Beach for a decade, and underwent several gradual clean ups and graphical updates. On 17 November 2025 it was replaced by a forest closely resembling one that existed in the area before the battle.

ml.name: Sliske's lair
ml.text: They also appear in Kindred Spirits, attacking Dharok the Wretched one-by-one in the Fighting Pit inside Sliske's lair.

place.title: Sliske's lair
place.summary: The first part of the dungeon consists of several caves with many diverging paths, with a supplied poem providing an effective map to the second part, a heavily guarded cave where wights, shadow clouds and security masks prevent further access. Beyond that is a massive vault door and several side caves, acting as the final barrier before the vault with the Stone of Jas itself.

Saradominist enforcer.examine: Zealously crushes skulls in melee combat.

ml.name: Wilderness Warbands
ml.text: Saradominist enforcer was a follower of Saradomin encountered during Wilderness Warbands. He could use melee abilities based on their attack styles during combat. They could use two-handed abilities such as Smash and Quake, even though they wielded a one-handed scimitar. However, they did not seem to be able to use dual-wield abilities.

place.title: Wilderness Warbands
place.summary: These camps were founded to gain an advantage for the followers of a particular God once their God returns. They would set up camp in the Wilderness every seven hours, one time at each of the three locations. Quercus, an ancient seer ent, would send out adventurers to fight in the camps to balance the followers of the different Gods in Guthix's name. Quercus could be found just outside north-west side of the Grand Exchange. Warbands events were synchronised on each world.

Falador (IPAc-en | ' | f | æ | l | ə | d | ɔːr Respell-en | FAL-ə-dor ) is the capital of Asgarnia. It serves as the base of operations for the White Knights and Temple Knights, two Saradominist knightly organisations. It has a significant role in the mining and smithing industries, with the south-eastern section of the city being home to both the Mining Guild and the Artisans' Workshop, and a mining dungeon under the eastern half of the city. Falador's population is usually around 40,000, although it swelled to almost 80,000 during the Siege of Falador.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
• Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.
• Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
• Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
• Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
• Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.
• Skills necklace or balloon transport system - Teleport to the Crafting Guild south-west of the city, and climb into the underwall tunnel shortcut (requires level 26 Agility Agility).

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.

Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the tool belt works), four planks, a bronze crossbow, mithril grapple, and four nails. It requires level 11 Agility, 19 Ranged, and 37 Strength to use.

Falador (IPAc-en | ' | f | æ | l | ə | d | ɔːr Respell-en | FAL-ə-dor ) is the capital of Asgarnia. It serves as the base of operations for the White Knights and Temple Knights, two Saradominist knightly organisations. It has a significant role in the mining and smithing industries, with the south-eastern section of the city being home to both the Mining Guild and the Artisans' Workshop, and a mining dungeon under the eastern half of the city. Falador's population is usually around 40,000, although it swelled to almost 80,000 during the Siege of Falador.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
• Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.
• Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
• Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
• Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
• Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.
• Skills necklace or balloon transport system - Teleport to the Crafting Guild south-west of the city, and climb into the underwall tunnel shortcut (requires level 26 Agility Agility).

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.

Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the tool belt works), four planks, a bronze crossbow, mithril grapple, and four nails. It requires level 11 Agility, 19 Ranged, and 37 Strength to use.

ml.name: Wilderness Warbands
ml.text: The Saradominist thaumaturge was a follower of Saradomin encountered during Wilderness Warbands. They primarily attacked their targets with magic, using the spell Fire Surge and various abilities. They wielded staves but their standard attacks were as fast as they would had been with a wand. In addition, they frequently used potent threshold abilities such as Asphyxiate and Wild Magic, and even ultimates such as Omnipower. For this reason they were considered among the deadliest of the monsters at the Saradomin camp, behind only their sergeant.

place.title: Temple of Aminishi
place.summary: The Temple of Aminishi, also known as ED1 or the Temple of Seiryu, is the first Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and dungeoneering tokens. The Temple of Aminishi is located on the island of Aminishi and requires completion of Impressing the Locals to access. The grouping system is required in order to form a team of 2-3 players.
place.teleport:
• Combat portal
• Boss portal
• Treasure chest (Elite Dungeons)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
• Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
• Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat (requires at least one boss kill from the dungeon).
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the Dungeoneering master cape to teleport to the entrance to Daemonheim Peninsula Island, and then run north to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Shadow Reef, the Dragonkin Laboratory, or the Zamorakian Undercity.

Ullek's tombs were famous for their advanced locking and trap mechanisms.

place.title: Ullek
place.summary: The area of Ullek is often called the Ruins of Ullek, particularly the plateau with the cliffs and buttes. The swamp area is often called the Swamps of Ullek. Under the plateau is a dungeon, which the High Priest of Scabaras refers to as the Scabarites' hive, and the tomb of Catolax.

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
The Ullek area in the south-eastern region of the Kharidian Desert. The approaches to the Ullek area plus Ullek plateau and the coastal area east of the swamp suffer from desert heat, so players are advised to bring water sources.

The area can be entered by travelling east from Sophanem and entering the swamp. The plateau can be reached by climbing up from the swamp, with the player first coming to an archaeologists' camp and then the monster-infested areas.

A shortcut allows access between the plateau and the Agility Pyramid area. However, the shortcut must first be set up, from the plateau, before it can be used. To do so, the player uses a rope on an overhanging rock at the westernmost part of the plateau just west of the archaeologists. The rope will permanently remain there as the shortcut. The shortcut requires 40 Agility.

It is recommended that the player bring a rope and set up the shortcut while doing Dealing with Scabaras, to save time later. Players should be aware that aggressive mummies infest the area around the shortcut on the plateau and should take precautions.

place.title: Sophanem Slayer Dungeon
place.summary: Upon attempting to enter the dungeon, players will receive a warning if they do not have any Feathers of Ma'at on them, or if they do not meet the Slayer level requirements to kill the monsters.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is accessed via the dungeon entrance south of the temple of Icthlarin. It can be easily reached through the following methods:
• The fastest method is to use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet. The ability to craft them is gained upon reaching rank 4 with any of the Menaphos factions.
• Leela's favour provides unlimited teleports to the dungeon entrance.
• The Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) can provide two free teleports to the entrance each day, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
• Use the Menaphos lodestone, go through the gate connecting the two cities, and run south-east. Using this method requires completion of Contact!.
• Teleport to the Luminous wisp colony south of Sophanem via the full Elder divination outfit or a skill portal in the Max garden and head north.
• Teleport to the Pyramid Plunder entrance in north Sophanem via the full Master camouflage outfit and head south.
• Take a magic carpet flight to Sophanem. Upon arrival, run south and the enter the gate.
• There are several access points to the magic carpet network, including:
• Shantay Pass to southern Pollnivneach to Sophanem
• Ring of slaying or the Slayer cape perk to Sumona in Pollnivneach and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.

Cairn Isle is an island on the south-west of Karamja, south of Tai Bwo Wannai and west of Shilo Village. To access the island, players must scale a small promontory stood on the Karamjan coastline by climbing up a rocks (requires 15 Agility), and then walk across the wooden bridge linking up the two islands. In case the player stumbles while climbing the rockslide, they will slide back down and take damage. If the player fails to keep their balance while crossing the bridge, they will fall off and be washed back to the shoreline of Karamja, again taking damage. It is advised to bring food if determined to make it to the island.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Main entrance: In the foothills of the Ice Mountain, north of the Falador to Gunnarsgrunn road. Using a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery is a quick way to get to this entrance.
• Falador entrance: A building in the far northeast of Falador has stairs down to the south end of the mine. A Falador Teleport is a fast way to get here and to get to the next entrance.
• South gate: Entrance to the Mining Guild, level 60 Mining required.
• Mine cart: Members may use the Keldagrim minecart system to enter the mine in the north-west section. This two-way network allows players to travel between the Dwarven Mine and the bustling dwarven capital of Keldagrim. From the cart station in Keldagrim, it is also possible to travel to White Wolf Mountain and the Grand Exchange, provided that the quest Fishing Contest has been completed. One fast way to get to the mine is to take the carts from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim and then to Ice Mountain. Also, the train station in Keldagrim is next to the carts and thus allows access from Dorgesh-Kaan, provided that the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest has been completed.
• After completing the Perils of Ice Mountain quest, a trapdoor route becomes available within the Power Station next to Ice Mountain. It leads to Nurmof's room.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

Like other combat resources on Uncharted Isles, they can drop a small amount of chimes when they are defeated. They will always be found near a pile of debris in the form of a smashed barrel, which acts as their spawn point.

place.title: Uncharted Isles
place.summary: The Uncharted Isles are a procedurally generated island exploration system that offers member players the ability to discover new, unmapped islands in The Arc region. The islands are high-level skilling destinations for Fishing, Woodcutting, Divination, Farming, Hunter and Mining. Each new island has effectively randomly generated hotspots and points of interest. There is no guarantee that any given island will have a specific resource present.

place.summary: The Temple of Aminishi, also known as ED1 or the Temple of Seiryu, is the first Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and dungeoneering tokens. The Temple of Aminishi is located on the island of Aminishi and requires completion of Impressing the Locals to access. The grouping system is required in order to form a team of 2-3 players.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
• Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
• Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat (requires at least one boss kill from the dungeon).
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the Dungeoneering master cape to teleport to the entrance to Daemonheim Peninsula Island, and then run north to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Shadow Reef, the Dragonkin Laboratory, or the Zamorakian Undercity.

place.title: Port Sarim
place.summary: Attempting to travel to Entrana with restricted items will open a full bank interface.
place.teleport: Port Sarim lodestone

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
• Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
• If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
• Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.
• Players can also travel to Port Sarim jail directly from Al Kharid by telling Shantay that they are outlaws. If they disagree to his terms, he will teleport them to Port Sarim jail. They can then pick the lock (both F2P and P2P) in their cell to get out.
• Fairy ring (code AIQ) travels to Mudskipper Point, the southern extent of Thurgo's Peninsula, south of Port Sarim.
• Using the teleport option on the Arc Journal obtained from Sharkborne. Requires completion of Impressing the Locals.
• Travel to Crafting Guild via the skills necklace or balloon transport system and walk to the south-east.

place.title: Icyene graveyard
place.summary: Gravestones and unfinished grave plots can be found scattering the area, with many tombstones depicting the names and a brief description of dead or fallen Icyene. Five of the tombstones are scratched out with animal marking and cannot be read.
place.teleport: None

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: It can be reached by using the shortcut in the south of the entrance area of the dig site. Icyene graveyard can also be accessed during and after the quest The Lord of Vampyrium via the boat in Burgh de Rott.

Seasinger priestess.examine: Bodyguard and acolyte to the Khan of the Sea.

ml.name: Uncharted Isles
ml.text: The Seasinger priestess is a bodyguard of Quin that can be found randomly on Uncharted Isles. Like most humanoids found on the Uncharted Isles, they are capable of using abilities in combat. While not aggressive, they are very accurate and hit very hard, and are clumped up in large groups, making it dangerous to use area-of-effect attacks and abilities. Weapon poison with corruption shot works well.

place.title: Uncharted Isles
place.summary: The Uncharted Isles are a procedurally generated island exploration system that offers member players the ability to discover new, unmapped islands in The Arc region. The islands are high-level skilling destinations for Fishing, Woodcutting, Divination, Farming, Hunter and Mining. Each new island has effectively randomly generated hotspots and points of interest. There is no guarantee that any given island will have a specific resource present.
place.teleport: Quartermaster Gully

Seeker.examine: A floating eye of some sort.
drops: Only dropped if fewer than five ancient effigies are owned.

ml.name: Stalker dungeon
pics: Stalker dungeon — wiki map (Default), red dots = spawns

place.title: Stalker dungeon
place.summary: At the north end of the dungeon there is a portal back to the stalker homeworld. Seeker's charms can be thrown into the portal to increase the chance of an elite soulgazer spawning. Soulgazer's charm has to be deposited here to get the baby soulgazer pet. Grondaban's stalker notes can be found near the portal.

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text: The dungeon is only accessible by entering the western door of Zamorak's hideout, which in turn is only accessible using the communication device obtained during Dishonour among Thieves. The device can be reclaimed from Moldark in Edgeville or May outside Varrock if lost.

Seeker (Dungeoneering).examine: A floating eye of some sort.

ml.name: Daemonheim
ml.text: The Seeker is a Slayer monster and Stalker found in Daemonheim; 71 Slayer is required to harm the Seeker. It is the only monster to drop the seeker's charm. It mainly attacks everyone in range with a magic attack in the shape of a green orb, though it is very inaccurate. It is often mistaken for a Soulgazer; which has a combat of 128 and is a completely different slayer monster that requires level 99 Slayer to kill. However, the Seeker doesn't have spikes like the Soulgazer, which is a good way to tell the two Stalker monsters apart.
pics: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.

place.title: Daemonheim
place.summary: Most of Daemonheim's history is told through the Chronicles of Bilrach, which are discovered as a player trains the Dungeoneering skill. Currently, an army of Fremenniks have set up a campsite in the area to prepare for their next expedition into the enormous labyrinths below the castle.
place.teleport:
• Ring of kinship
• Tower of Voices

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor.
• Teleporting to Daemonheim Dig Site by using the dig sites map located in the Archaeology Guild (with level 73 Archaeology after rescuing Skaldrun).
• Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.
• Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to the Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers.
• Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
• War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.
pics: The place where players arrive if they travel to Daemonheim by boat.

Seething Pyrefiend.examine: More than a bit hot headed.

ml.name: The Zamorakian Undercity
ml.text: Seething Pyrefiend is a monster released with The Zamorakian Undercity.

place.title: The Zamorakian Undercity
place.summary: While it is considered an Elite Dungeon (with its own luck charms and ability to teleport to the other Elite Dungeons) it is noticeably different compared to the previous three; the health of enemies scales to the party size (and are also more dangerous) and its luck charm costs slightly more and cannot be converted. It also possesses an enrage system that goes up in intervals of 100% past 4,000% enrage, and the enemies' strengths, types, and quantities begin to change as it increases, capping at 60,000%. Players are free to choose their enrage from 0 to 4,000%. Clearing the undercity increases the rewards obtained from Zamorak.
place.teleport:
• Boss portal (Max Guild)
• Boss portal (War's Retreat)
• Treasure chest (Elite Dungeons)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The entrance to the dungeon is located east of the pulley, which is used to enter Senntisten behind the Ancient door just north of the Archaeology Guild.
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
• Use the Pontifex Shadow Ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, to teleport to Senntisten, run north to the Pulley.
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
• Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (Key press | 3 ) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
• Dig site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
• Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
• Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
• Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box can be used to teleport to the north-east of the ancient door.
• Teleport to Earth altar, or using Fort Forinthry Teleport to the north-west of the ancient door.
• Ride the balloon to Varrock to the north-west of the ancient door.
• Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select The Zamorakian Undercity (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside Temple of Aminishi, The Shadow Reef, or the Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).

place.title: Temple of Aminishi
place.summary: The Temple of Aminishi, also known as ED1 or the Temple of Seiryu, is the first Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and dungeoneering tokens. The Temple of Aminishi is located on the island of Aminishi and requires completion of Impressing the Locals to access. The grouping system is required in order to form a team of 2-3 players.
place.teleport:
• Combat portal
• Boss portal
• Treasure chest (Elite Dungeons)

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
• Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
• Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat (requires at least one boss kill from the dungeon).
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the Dungeoneering master cape to teleport to the entrance to Daemonheim Peninsula Island, and then run north to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Shadow Reef, the Dragonkin Laboratory, or the Zamorakian Undercity.

ml.name: Heart of Gielinor
pics: Heart of Gielinor — wiki map (The Heart), red dots = spawns
The entrance area of The Heart

place.title: Heart of Gielinor
place.summary: The Heart of Gielinor is a mid-to-high combat area. As with the original God Wars Dungeon, the player must obtain killcount to access each general's chambers, obtained by killing a certain number of soldiers of the respective faction. The only exception to this is Telos, who does not need any killcount (though the player needs to kill the generals of the other factions first).
place.teleport:
• The Heart teleport
• Boss portal
• Combat portal

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
• Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
• Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.
• The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
• Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
• Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
• Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
• Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
• Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
• Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
• Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
• Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
• Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
• Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
• Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros

Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.

Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

ml.name: Temple Trekking
ml.text: Shades are monsters that can be encountered in Temple Trekking while travelling along the hard route, which attempt to break into the houses of the three unafflicted people in Mort'ton. On occasion they have also been known to leave their catacombs to attack trekkers and ramblers in the town above their dark burial place.

place.title: Temple Trekking
place.summary: Temple Trekking is a minigame in which players must escort victims of vampyre rule from Burgh de Rott through Morytania to Paterdomus, which requires completion of the In Aid of the Myreque quest. On the way, the player must pass through Morytania's many dangers and obstacles, protecting the accompanying traveller until they reach the temple. The player must find a way across bogs and rivers and fight dangerous packs of monsters lurking in Morytania, some unique to this minigame.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Temple Trekking starts at the town of Burgh de Rott by the northern gate. Start the minigame by reading the noticeboard nearby.

Burgh de Rott Ramble starts on the east side of the River Salve just outside Paterdomus. A player can start on either side.

There are several ways to reach Canifis or Burgh de Rott quickly where the minigame may be started. Some of these include:
• Drakan's medallion teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• Games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale). 
• Kharyrll Teleport (requires completion of Desert Treasure and 66 Magic).
• Fairy ring code CKS (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest and getting permission from the Fairy Godfather and at least a dramen staff if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and Lunar Diplomacy are not completed).
• Teleport to Canifis via the Canifis lodestone and enter the long cave through the trapdoor behind the pub for exit near the rowboat to Mort'ton.
• Teleport to the Slayer Tower just north of Canifis using a slayer ring.

ml.name: Mort'ton
ml.text: Shades are monsters that can be encountered in Temple Trekking while travelling along the hard route, which attempt to break into the houses of the three unafflicted people in Mort'ton. On occasion they have also been known to leave their catacombs to attack trekkers and ramblers in the town above their dark burial place.

place.title: Mort'ton
place.summary: The town was once famed for its funeral pyres, though now it is populated by afflicted, strange zombie-like creatures that are the result of a disease which spread through the town some time in the Fifth Age, infecting the population, and Shades of long-dead spirits which were disturbed by the town's affliction.
place.teleport: See getting there section

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• After levelling Zachory Bragg to level 99 in Temple Trekking the trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis takes players directly to Mort'ton.
• A games necklace can be used to teleport to the nearby town of Burgh de Rott after unlocking the destination by playing Temple Trekking.
• Drakan's medallion can be used to teleport to the Barrows or Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• Teleport to the Barrows via a boss portal.
• A Swamp Boat can be taken directly to Mort'ton from the Hollows in the Mort Myre Swamp. The boat can be reached by the following methods:
• From Canifis via the tunnel behind the Hair of the Dog tavern (after In Search of the Myreque)
• From the BKR fairy ring in the Mort Myre Swamp.
• Running south from Canifis through Mort Myre Swamp. The northwestern gate requires starting the Nature Spirit quest.

leagueRegion: Wilderness

The Chaos Tunnels are a large dungeon network located in low-level Wilderness, north of Edgeville. It is in a members-only region. It does not require any quests to be accessed. If players attempt to exit the Chaos Tunnels while opted into PvP, they will receive a warning prompt about it before they can continue.
place.teleport:
• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
• North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
• East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
• North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
• North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
• North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

ml.name: Heart of Gielinor
ml.text: Shadow demons can be found in the Heart of Gielinor. They can be fought for killcount for the Sliske faction.
pics: The entrance area of The Heart

place.title: Heart of Gielinor
place.summary: The Heart of Gielinor is a mid-to-high combat area. As with the original God Wars Dungeon, the player must obtain killcount to access each general's chambers, obtained by killing a certain number of soldiers of the respective faction. The only exception to this is Telos, who does not need any killcount (though the player needs to kill the generals of the other factions first).
place.teleport:
• The Heart teleport
• Boss portal
• Combat portal

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
• Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
• Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.
• The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
• Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
• Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
• Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
• Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
• Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
• Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
• Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
• Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
• Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
• Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
• Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros

Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.

Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.
pics: The entrance area of The Heart

place.title: Freneskae
place.summary: Once considered a "perfect" world, Freneskae is now a dark wasteland. Its toxic atmosphere is riddled with constant lightning storms, volcanic eruptions and lava flows near its surface of bare rock. Its native life struggles to survive in the harsh climate, and as a result it is a world of constant warfare. In addition to the Mahjarrat, Freneskae was home to the Mahserrat, Mahkorat, and the Chelon-Mah, and is the only world on which muspah and nihil may be found.
place.teleport: World Gate

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Freneskae may be accessed after starting Fate of the Gods, by means of the World Gate, located north of the Arandar and south of the Eagles' Peak. Fate of the Gods takes place almost entirely on Freneskae, and after the quest is completed, Freneskae remains open for exploration. To access Freneskae through the world gate, it must be dialled to . 

The world gate itself may be reached by:
• Sixth-Age circuit teleport to World Gate (option 2).
• Quest Cape or master quest cape teleport to World Gate (option 0).
• Eagles' Peak lodestone and run south.
• Traveller's necklace teleport to The outpost (option 2) and run west.

ml.name: Waterfall Dungeon
pics: Waterfall Dungeon — wiki map (Waterfall cave), red dots = spawns

place.title: Waterfall Dungeon
place.summary: During the Waterfall Quest the dungeon is accessed in search of the Chalice of Eternity, containing the treasure of the elven king Baxtorian. During the Roving Elves quest the dungeon must be entered again to consecrate the resting place of queen Glarial. During The Light Within it is discovered that Baxtorian changed himself into a crystal statue and that the statue of Glarial, his wife, contained the Seren shard of integrity.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is in northern Kandarin, and is entered through an outcrop on the face of the Baxtorian Falls. To enter the dungeon the player must have Glarial's amulet and a rope. Go through Almera's house near the falls and out the back gate, use the log raft there to float to an island in the river. From there, get to the next island by using the rope on the rock there. On the second island, use the rope on the dead tree and lower yourself to the ledge on the falls. With Glarial's amulet equipped or in your inventory, enter the dungeon.

The quickest teleport to the area is by teleporting with the games necklace or lunar spell Barbarian Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost, which is directly to the north of Almera's house. Another option, requiring the completion of The Grand Tree and 37 Agility, is to take the Spirit Tree to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and go north, northeast past the Grand Tree, down the tree shortcut and past the lake. Alternatively the player can run north-west from the Ardougne lodestone, past the Fishing Guild and up the fenced mountain path to Almera's house.

Player can also use the fairy ring code BJQ to enter the Ancient Caverns and use the log there to travel to the foot of the falls, close to Almera's house.

The Dungeoneering cape can teleport the user directly to the entrance of the Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon, found in the centre-north room of the dungeon.

Players with 24 Construction may build a rope rack, providing unlimited coils of rope, next to the raft that leads to the Waterfall Dungeon. This requires a saw and hammer (tool-belt tools will suffice), five coils of rope and three oak planks. Alternatively, if the player has allocated 50 points into the pet track at May's Quest Caravan, Lorehound pet can be summoned, providing a free rope.

Note: Do not attempt to swim across or climb down the tree without a rope, as this will fail and you will be washed quite a way down the river and dealt some damage. This also applies when attempting to enter the cavern without having the amulet (not required to wear).

A barrel is located next to the dungeon's entrance, allowing the players to leave the area, leaving them near Gerald, in the same spot as being washed out, but without taking damage. It was originally necessary if the players did not have access to any means of teleporting out, however due to the large number of currently available teleport options this method of leaving dungeon is largely obsolete.

getting_there.text:

• The Home Teleport spell to Al Kharid lodestone is also free with no requirements, and is the only free-to-play option.

getting_there.heading: Transport to Port Sarim
getting_there.text:
Players can be arrested and placed in a cell at Port Sarim jail. This can be a useful way of effectively teleporting for free, but the delay caused by failed attempts at escaping makes this less attractive than it used to be. To be arrested by the guards, players can do the following:
• Talk to Shantay and say: "What is this place?" - if this is not the first time being arrested, or the player had already been arrested but had not talked to Shantay before, complete the dialogue and then repeat this.
• Say: "I am definitely an outlaw, prepare to die!"
• You will be put in his tiny jail
• Then, say "Deport me to Port Sarim!"

The player will then be sent to Port Sarim jail. To escape, players can pick the lock on the door. When done successfully, the player will exit the cell.

This will give the player Thieving experience, but only on a members server. Also, no equipment is required and can be done by free players.

ml.name: Aminishi
ml.text: Before joining the acolytes of Seiryu, Elei used to live in the Bay of Echoes. At some point her father was killed by pirates and as a result she often had nightmares about him; she missed him greatly and became very attached to a book he gave her where she wrote her diary. Throughout the rest of her life she felt that she had no purpose, and felt that she could change that by volunteering to join the acolytes on Aminishi.

ml.name: Temple of Aminishi

place.title: Temple of Aminishi
place.summary: The Temple of Aminishi, also known as ED1 or the Temple of Seiryu, is the first Elite Dungeon, a 1-3 player combat/narrative experience that rewards unique loot and Dungeoneering experience and dungeoneering tokens. The Temple of Aminishi is located on the island of Aminishi and requires completion of Impressing the Locals to access. The grouping system is required in order to form a team of 2-3 players.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
• Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
• Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat (requires at least one boss kill from the dungeon).
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
• Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the Dungeoneering master cape to teleport to the entrance to Daemonheim Peninsula Island, and then run north to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select Temple of Aminishi.
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside the Shadow Reef, the Dragonkin Laboratory, or the Zamorakian Undercity.

place.title: Nodon Front
place.summary: The front has no requirements to access; however, 92 Slayer is required to fight Nodon dragonkin in this part of the dungeon, and 90 Construction is required to repair the siege weapons and use them against the enemy. It is also recommended to have at least level 80 in combat skills, as well as tier-80 equipment. Additionally, the completion of Sliske's Endgame and City of Senntisten is recommended for a better understanding of the story, as the front is considered the next instalment in the ongoing Elder God Wars narrative. The Shard of Erebus makes the Nodon dragonkin unaggressive towards the player, and the pontifex shadow ring can be upgraded with 1,000 resonant anima of Jas acquired from defeating enemies in the Front.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The Nodon Front is located in the western section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift. After entering Senntisten the player needs to access the cathedral to the south of the entrance and then leave through the western cathedral door. Passing through the western door for the first time triggers a cutscene.

Travel methods include:
• Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door east of the Rift.
• Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (3) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.
• The Pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.
• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology Archaeology or access to those items.
• The boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of Kerapac, the bound) or the boss portal in the Max Guild (doesn't require a kill) can be attuned to teleport the player to the colosseum gateway, right next to the market area.
• Use the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping to teleport to the Senntisten Asylum.

place.summary: The Dark Lord, a part of Seren trapped by the Temple of Light kept whispering to people who went into the pass, and corrupted anyone who entered.

getting_there.heading: Travelling through
getting_there.text:
The following only contains information on how to get through the pass after the quest is done.

The player will not be able to enter Iban's Temple and the elven lands until the player has spoken to King Lathas at the start of Regicide. The player's quest journal will mention about assassinating his brother if they have talked to him.

Travelling through Underground path

To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.

These items are needed:
• A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
• A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
• A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
• Food to survive traps and monsters

Part 1

Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
• Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
• Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
• Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.
• Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
• Go to the north.
• Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
• Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
• Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
• Continue going south, then east.
• Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
• Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.
• You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.

Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass 
Checklist | * Once past the spike traps, pull the lever to the south and the portcullis will rise. Do not take the obstacle pipe because it's only one-way and you will have to redo guide rope obstacle.
• After passing the gate, you should be in a room full of zombies. Head west past the furnace.
• Continue going west, and as you run past the spear wall traps, you might take some damage. If you have a good Thieving level you can try to disable them by searching the odd markings on the wall. You may take multiple triple-digit damage per trap if you try to run past without disabling them. Area prevents you from using abilities like Surge so it is best to disarm the traps. Search on the odd markings on the wall, then run two tiles ahead of you. With run active, your character will run past the wall trap without activating it. You'll only take damage if you run across them all at once.
• Next, climb down the well.

Part 2

Checklist | * Head west towards the cages of slaves.
• Enter the south-east cage and dig up the mud. This will take you to the back of the cage.
• Follow the path and cross the ledge (if you fail, you will reach back to the cell area).
• In the next area you have a couple choices.
• If you have 50 Thieving, you may pick the locks on two cages by following the southward path. Once past the cage, make sure you don't step on the bubbles, or you'll have to start back at the beginning.
• Otherwise, head onto the wooden bridges, balancing over the narrow parts. Take the right path, left, then finally, the left again. The higher your Agility level, the less your chance of failing it.
• Whichever path you took, follow the path to the south and squeeze through the pipe.

Part 3

Checklist | * Go past the smashed cage and pass through the tunnel on the north side of the cave.
• Follow the passage until you pass the zombies and see paladins.
• Use the plank found earlier on either one of the flat rock traps to get past.
• Continue forward, open the door, and you will be standing in Iban's lair.

Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair

Checklist | * After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
• Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
• If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave. 
• Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step. 
• After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins. 
• Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
• Ascend the stairs. 
• If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
• Heading south, cross the third walkway.
• Jump over the bridge to the first platform.
• From the first platform, go southeast to a second platform.
• From the second platform, take the eastern path over a winding bridge to the third platform. There should be some red-cloaked Disciples of Iban on this platform.
• Proceed south for a bridge jump.
• Take the western path closest to the Temple of Iban stairs.
• Open the temple door.
• Doing so will unlock the Well of Voyage music track. 
• You can talk to Koftik here if you have completed the Underground Pass quest, who will give you some food if you were hurt by the traps.
• Climb-down the well.
• Head west past the glowing obelisks and exit the cave.

place.title: Underground Pass
place.summary: Underground Pass is a quest named after the location in which it takes place. You must venture into an underground pathway that leads to a new land at the request of King Lathas of Ardougne to help him destroy his corrupted brother, Tyras. The quest continues the story from Spirit of the Pass.

ml.name: West Ardougne
ml.text: During Plague's End, he accompanies Sir Edmond to West Ardougne to see the citizenry and an adventurer have ousted the mourners and seized their headquarters. He rejects the proclamation and declares it is King Lathas' right to do as he wish, having the divine right to rule. He leaves to go guard the king, and dies in battle against the adventurer who attacks the castle alongside the Ardougne knights and heroes.

place.title: West Ardougne
place.summary: The city is first accessed during the Plague City quest and is an important setting of the elf (Prifddinas) quest series.
place.teleport: 'Chipped' Ardougne teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are only a few ways to enter West Ardougne, with some of them only available during specific quests.
• Through the main door in the West Ardougne eastern wall after the Biohazard quest.
• Use the Ardougne lodestone and run south and west across the river.
• Use a spirit tree to teleport to the Khazard battlefield and run north and enter West Ardougne through the wall
• Use the Ardougne Teleport to arrive in the East Ardougne centre and run west across the river and around the castle.
• Use Kandarin monastery Teleport (requires unlocking Ardougne cloak 1) to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery and run north-west across the river.
• Breaking a 'Chipped' Ardougne teleport to arrive just south-east of the main doors of the Civic Office of West Ardougne. Requires the completion of Plague City, Evil Dave's Big Day Out and 51 Magic.
• Through the pipeline in the sewers under Edmond's house after the partial completion of the Plague City quest. This way becomes inaccessible after the Biohazard quest is started.
• Talking to Omart near the southern end of the eastern wall during the Biohazard quest. After the quest the passage over the wall can be used only from West to East Ardougne by talking to Kilron. The wall cannot be passed this way anymore after Plague's End.
• Through the Underground Pass from Tirannwn. Requires starting Regicide.
• Using a crystal teleport seed or its attuned version to teleport to the Temple of Light. Run east of through the Mourner tunnels and climb the ladder to Mourner Headquarters. Requires the completion of Within the Light.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The northernmost tunnel entrance is in Canifis, through the trapdoor south of the tavern. For those claimed the shortcut reward for training Zachory Bragg to level 99, they can be deactivated the reward by reading the Temple Trekking noticeboard near Paterdomus and selecting the "reward" option on the Zachory's level 99 "Shortcut" reward.

The tunnel entrance at the southern end of the northern section is in Mort Myre Swamp, through the wooden doors south of the tavern.

The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.

The following are other alternative ways to get to there:
• Drakan's medallion can teleport players to the laboratory.
• The southern tunnel entrance is in north-eastern Meiyerditch in the third building from the top along the eastern wall.
• Fairy ring code DLS transports a player to the north-west corner of the tunnels.
• Another quick way to get to this tunnels is to go into the abyss, then through the blood altar and exit it to appear in the cave. However, travelling through the abyss will drain a player's prayer.
• Use a blood altar teleport tablet to blood altar.
• A mask of Broken Fingers or its upgraded version can teleport players to these tunnels twice per day, near the zombie hands.
• A mask of Crimson or its upgraded version can teleport players to these tunnels twice per day, near the aggressive mutated bloodvelds.

Players can travel between different sections through the basement wall and then immediately head east through the cave entrance to Ivandis' tomb. Go through the south cave entrance into the tunnels. It requires Agility level 65 to pass through the jutting wall shortcut.

Attempting the north cave entrance before completing the quest In Aid of the Myreque gives the message: You're not sure where this leads to and have an ominous feeling it leads nowhere good. You decide not to go through.

place.title: Abandoned Mine
place.summary: The mine has six levels. It has many ore veins, which yield mithril, coal, luminite, drakolith, and phasmatite in addition to the crystal mine. In the quest, you cut a piece of crystal to make a salve amulet, and you can do so again any time after the quest.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
Map:Abandoned Mine surface 
The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.

getting_there.heading: Accessing the crystal mine
getting_there.text:
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
• Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.

Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.

To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.

To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).

To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K on level 4 (to get to the mine/collect key):

#Level 4: Go K - 10; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 10 - 9; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 9 - 13; take lift down to level 5.

To get a new crystal-mine key (skip to next group if you have the key):

# Level 5: Go 14; climb down.

#Level 6: Go 14; climb up to get back to level 5.

# Level 5: Go 15; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 15 - U (unlock door with key) - Y (crystal mine).

place.title: Abandoned Mine
place.summary: The mine has six levels. It has many ore veins, which yield mithril, coal, luminite, drakolith, and phasmatite in addition to the crystal mine. In the quest, you cut a piece of crystal to make a salve amulet, and you can do so again any time after the quest.
