getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
Map:Abandoned Mine surface 
The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.

getting_there.heading: Accessing the crystal mine
getting_there.text:
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
• Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.

Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.

To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.

To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).

To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K on level 4 (to get to the mine/collect key):

#Level 4: Go K - 10; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 10 - 9; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 9 - 13; take lift down to level 5.

To get a new crystal-mine key (skip to next group if you have the key):

# Level 5: Go 14; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 14 - T (take innocent-looking key; turns into crystal-mine key, can be added to the key ring).
#Level 6: Go 14; climb up to get back to level 5.

To get to the crystal mine (with the crystal-mine key):
# Level 5: Go 15; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 15 - U (unlock door with key) - Y (crystal mine).

place.title: Edgeville Dungeon
place.summary: Another entrance is west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key which can be found in the dungeon. It is useful to players who wish to collect big bones, since it leads right down to a group of Hill Giants and is fairly close to the Varrock bank. Alternatively, members can use the bank in the Cooking guild, which is nearer, provided they have completed the Hard set of the Varrock tasks.

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
There are two entrances to the dungeon. The most common is in Edgeville, in the ruins south of the bank. It is marked by a mark on the minimap.

Another entrance is west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key which can be found in the dungeon. It is useful to players who wish to collect big bones, since it leads right down to a group of Hill Giants and is fairly close to the Varrock bank. Alternatively, members can use the bank in the Cooking guild, which is nearer, provided they have completed the Hard set of the Varrock tasks.

Enclave guard, at the entrance outside the enclave

place.title: Ogre Enclave
place.summary: The Ogre Enclave is a dungeon located in Gu'Tanoth. It requires partial completion of the Watchtower quest to enter. The entrance to the enclave is in the western part of the ogre marketplace in the centre of Gu'Tanoth. During the quest, the player must use a cave nightshade on the ogre guard to gain entry. After the quest, this is no longer required. The cave contains the crystals for the Watchtower quest.

ml.name: Senntisten Temple
pics: Senntisten Temple — wiki map (Senntisten Temple), red dots = spawns

place.title: Senntisten Temple
place.summary: The Temple was once part of Senntisten, the capital of the Zarosian Empire. After Zamorak banished Zaros, the Temple, along with rest of the capital, was overrun by Zamorak forces. The remains of the city were only recently uncovered.

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
There are five ways of getting to the Temple:
# Use a Dig Site pendant
# Use a gnome glider from the Grand Tree to destination Lemanto Andra
# Use the Senntisten Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook
# Walk from Varrock or Al Kharid to the Varrock Dig Site
#Use the Archaeology Journal and run north

The two parts of the dungeon are in different locations with respect to one another that you would expect from their surface entrances. The northeast winch leads to the chamber that is south-west of the west winch's entrance point. Use the winch at the western part of the Varrock Dig Site to enter the Temple.

getting_there.heading: Dungeon from the west winch entrance
getting_there.text:
This is a single chamber, containing Doug Deeping, two arcenia root spawns, and several iron pickaxe and bucket spawns.

The sacks in the north part of the chamber are the object of a Treasure Trails clue.

getting_there.heading: Dungeon from the east winch entrance
getting_there.text:
A Rope must first be used on this winch before you can use it.

Upon entry, the player is in a small chamber with the rope to the surface and two arcenia root spawns. The chamber to the north-east has a barrel with nitroglycerine in it, a chest which contains ammonium nitrate and a spawn for the book on chemicals.

The southern end of the dungeon differs depending upon the player's quest progress. During The Dig Site quest, the large chamber to the south is blocked by bricks and piles of rocks. The player demolishes this barrier during the quest, using explosive chemicals the player makes. The south part of the dungeon has only a single chamber, which contains the stone tablet. It also contains level 22 skeletons, many bones spawns, and five silver rocks. After completing The Temple at Senntisten quest, the southern end of the dungeon has two chambers. The south chamber no longer has skeletons but, along with holding the Altar of Zaros, there are four tool tables containing bronze pickaxes, hammers, saws, and chisels, which the player may take. The chamber still contains many bones but only one silver rock. The south-west chamber contains level 22 skeletons.

pics: Stronghold of Security (4th level) — wiki map (Stronghold of Security), red dots = spawns
Entrance to the Stronghold of Security

ml.name: Taverley Dungeon
pics: Taverley Dungeon — wiki map (Taverley Dungeon), red dots = spawns

place.title: Taverley Dungeon
place.summary: The dungeon has the entrances of two resource dungeons: the hellhound and blue dragon resource dungeon. These require 55 and 60 minimum Dungeoneering levels to enter, respectively. The blue dragon chamber of the dungeon and the resource dungeon accessed from this chamber are the only locations where blue dragon scales (used for Herblore) spawn.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The entrance to the dungeon is found south of Taverley and west of Falador. After the update UD | Troll Warzone , it was relocated closer to a bank - directly south of the dock past the bridge by the wheat patch. (The boat carries to Daemonheim, and from there to Al Kharid or back to Taverley).

The Obelisk of Water on an island can only be reached by traversing the dungeon. The island is just off the coast near Catherby. There is a one-way mithril grapple shortcut from the island to the shore which requires 36 Agility, 39 Ranged, and 22 Strength.

pics: Temple of Ikov (dungeon) — wiki map (Temple of Ikov), red dots = spawns

place.title: Temple of Ikov (dungeon)
place.summary: It is located north of East Ardougne, just south of the Ranging Guild.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The closest fairy ring location is BLR.
• The player may teleport to the Ranging Guild using a combat bracelet.
• Players who have completed the hard Ardougne achievements can use the Manor farm Teleport to the south of the main entrance.
• Near the end of the dungeon, there is a ladder leading up to a small building with a locked door adjacent to McGrubor's Wood. This door can be opened using the shiny key that spawns at the very end of the dungeon. This ladder along with the shiny key allows players easy access to the end of the dungeon. The shiny key can be added to the steel key ring.

ml.name: Underground Pass (dungeon)
pics: Underground Pass (dungeon) — wiki map (Underground path), red dots = spawns
The entrance to the Underground Pass

place.title: Underground Pass (dungeon)
place.summary: The Dark Lord, a part of Seren trapped by the Temple of Light kept whispering to people who went into the pass, and corrupted anyone who entered.

getting_there.heading: Travelling through
getting_there.text:
The following only contains information on how to get through the pass after the quest is done.

The player will not be able to enter Iban's Temple and the elven lands until the player has spoken to King Lathas at the start of Regicide. The player's quest journal will mention about assassinating his brother if they have talked to him.

Travelling through Underground path

To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.

These items are needed:
• A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
• A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
• A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
• Food to survive traps and monsters

Part 1

Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
• Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
• Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
• Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.
• Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
• Go to the north.
• Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
• Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
• Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
• Continue going south, then east.
• Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
• Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.
• You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.

Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass 
Checklist | * Once past the spike traps, pull the lever to the south and the portcullis will rise. Do not take the obstacle pipe because it's only one-way and you will have to redo guide rope obstacle.
• After passing the gate, you should be in a room full of zombies. Head west past the furnace.
• Continue going west, and as you run past the spear wall traps, you might take some damage. If you have a good Thieving level you can try to disable them by searching the odd markings on the wall. You may take multiple triple-digit damage per trap if you try to run past without disabling them. Area prevents you from using abilities like Surge so it is best to disarm the traps. Search on the odd markings on the wall, then run two tiles ahead of you. With run active, your character will run past the wall trap without activating it. You'll only take damage if you run across them all at once.
• Next, climb down the well.

Part 2

Checklist | * Head west towards the cages of slaves.
• Enter the south-east cage and dig up the mud. This will take you to the back of the cage.
• Follow the path and cross the ledge (if you fail, you will reach back to the cell area).
• In the next area you have a couple choices.
• If you have 50 Thieving, you may pick the locks on two cages by following the southward path. Once past the cage, make sure you don't step on the bubbles, or you'll have to start back at the beginning.
• Otherwise, head onto the wooden bridges, balancing over the narrow parts. Take the right path, left, then finally, the left again. The higher your Agility level, the less your chance of failing it.
• Whichever path you took, follow the path to the south and squeeze through the pipe.

Part 3

Checklist | * Go past the smashed cage and pass through the tunnel on the north side of the cave.
• Follow the passage until you pass the zombies and see paladins.
• Use the plank found earlier on either one of the flat rock traps to get past.
• Continue forward, open the door, and you will be standing in Iban's lair.

Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair

Checklist | * After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
• Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
• If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave. 
• Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step. 
• After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins. 
• Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
• Ascend the stairs. 
• If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
• Heading south, cross the third walkway.
• Jump over the bridge to the first platform.
• From the first platform, go southeast to a second platform.
• From the second platform, take the eastern path over a winding bridge to the third platform. There should be some red-cloaked Disciples of Iban on this platform.
• Proceed south for a bridge jump.
• Take the western path closest to the Temple of Iban stairs.
• Open the temple door.
• Doing so will unlock the Well of Voyage music track. 
• You can talk to Koftik here if you have completed the Underground Pass quest, who will give you some food if you were hurt by the traps.
• Climb-down the well.
• Head west past the glowing obelisks and exit the cave.

ml.name: Varrock Sewers
pics: Varrock Sewers — wiki map (Misthalin Underground), red dots = spawns
Phingspet, just north of the sewer entrance

place.title: Varrock Sewers
place.summary: Varrock Sewers are filled with corridors and rooms. Members can find some of the monsters here to be useful, because the zombies and the moss giants drop herbs (for Herblore) and seeds (for Farming).

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text: The Varrock Sewers can be accessed via a manhole just east of Varrock Palace or via an Agility shortcut in Edgeville Dungeon.

ml.name: Waterfall Dungeon
pics: Waterfall Dungeon — wiki map (Waterfall cave), red dots = spawns

place.title: Waterfall Dungeon
place.summary: During the Waterfall Quest the dungeon is accessed in search of the Chalice of Eternity, containing the treasure of the elven king Baxtorian. During the Roving Elves quest the dungeon must be entered again to consecrate the resting place of queen Glarial. During The Light Within it is discovered that Baxtorian changed himself into a crystal statue and that the statue of Glarial, his wife, contained the Seren shard of integrity.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is in northern Kandarin, and is entered through an outcrop on the face of the Baxtorian Falls. To enter the dungeon the player must have Glarial's amulet and a rope. Go through Almera's house near the falls and out the back gate, use the log raft there to float to an island in the river. From there, get to the next island by using the rope on the rock there. On the second island, use the rope on the dead tree and lower yourself to the ledge on the falls. With Glarial's amulet equipped or in your inventory, enter the dungeon.

The quickest teleport to the area is by teleporting with the games necklace or lunar spell Barbarian Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost, which is directly to the north of Almera's house. Another option, requiring the completion of The Grand Tree and 37 Agility, is to take the Spirit Tree to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and go north, northeast past the Grand Tree, down the tree shortcut and past the lake. Alternatively the player can run north-west from the Ardougne lodestone, past the Fishing Guild and up the fenced mountain path to Almera's house.

Player can also use the fairy ring code BJQ to enter the Ancient Caverns and use the log there to travel to the foot of the falls, close to Almera's house.

The Dungeoneering cape can teleport the user directly to the entrance of the Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon, found in the centre-north room of the dungeon.

Players with 24 Construction may build a rope rack, providing unlimited coils of rope, next to the raft that leads to the Waterfall Dungeon. This requires a saw and hammer (tool-belt tools will suffice), five coils of rope and three oak planks. Alternatively, if the player has allocated 50 points into the pet track at May's Quest Caravan, Lorehound pet can be summoned, providing a free rope.

Note: Do not attempt to swim across or climb down the tree without a rope, as this will fail and you will be washed quite a way down the river and dealt some damage. This also applies when attempting to enter the cavern without having the amulet (not required to wear).

A barrel is located next to the dungeon's entrance, allowing the players to leave the area, leaving them near Gerald, in the same spot as being washed out, but without taking damage. It was originally necessary if the players did not have access to any means of teleporting out, however due to the large number of currently available teleport options this method of leaving dungeon is largely obsolete.
pics: A player swimming to the 2nd island with the aid of a rope.

ml.name: Wilderness (north of Edgeville)
pics: Wilderness (north of Edgeville) — wiki map (RuneScape Surface), red dots = spawns
Four types of abyssal demons roam around the obelisk and the north entrance of Forinthry Dungeon.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

place.title: Barrows
place.summary: This village may be the remains of the camp of the Saradominist army that invaded Morytania on their crusade to free the region, known as the Morytania Campaign. When the six brothers succumbed to their wounds, their men made a camp here and buried them at the barrows.
place.teleport: Drakan's medallion

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Drakan's medallion, obtained from the The Branches of Darkmeyer quest, has a teleport directly to the Barrows and it can be used to teleport directly south of the Burgh de Rott bank.
• Use games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott and run north-east (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale and combined 500 companion levels from Temple Trekking).
• After completing the Nature Spirit quest, the swamp boat can be taken for free to the bridge between Mort'ton and the Barrows.
• There is a fairy ring in Mort Myre Swamp that can be used to reach the swamp boat. It can be accessed by code BKR. 
• After completion of In Search of the Myreque you can use the trapdoor south of the Hair of the Dog in Canifis to access a faster shortcut to the boat.
• Once you have completed the encounter of the Barrows Brothers at least once, players can use the boss portal or reaper portal at War's Retreat. Players can also use the combat portal in the Max Guild, which does not require them to have previously killed the boss.
• Use the Canifis lodestone or Kharyrll teleport and walk through Mort Myre Swamp – the slowest method is walking through the swamps from Canifis.

place.title: Dark Warriors' Fortress
place.summary: The Dark Warriors' Fortress, formerly called the Dark Knight Fortress, is a castle in levels 19, 20, and 21 of the Wilderness. It is populated with level 32 skeletons, who were formerly dark warriors.
place.teleport: None

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Enter the Wilderness from the wall north of the Goblin Village and run north until you reach the bridge over the moat.
• Enter the Wilderness from the wall north of the Edgeville Monastery and run north until you reach the southern portion of the moat that surrounds the fortress. Then run west and then north until you reach the bridge that allows access.
• The fastest route is to exit the Chaos altar via the portal next to the rune altar. 
• Players may also opt to use the Ancient Obelisk or a portable obelisk to teleport to the location north of the Bandit Camp (level 27 Wilderness) and run south. Caution: the NPCs in the Bandit Camp are aggressive to any player that is not skulled.
• Dareeyak Teleport from the Ancient spellbook teleports the player to the ruins north-west of the fortress.

place.title: Draynor Manor
place.summary: In the south-west corner of the property is a fountain, which is a plot device in the Ernest the Chicken quest. Directly to the west of the manor is a compost heap (also a plot device involved in Ernest the Chicken), and a patch of special cabbages. These cabbages are unique in that they boost Defence 1 to 2 levels temporarily. During the course of the Black Knights' Fortress quest, these cabbages are referenced by the witch brewing the "doomsday potion" (incidentally, one cannot use a cabbage from here during the quest - the game will not let players actually ruin the quest). Right next to the cabbages is an evil turnip patch, where members can grow an evil turnip for Summoning. It is the only location to have a nightshade patch, which Ayesha the farmer says is due to the grounds of the manor being "unblessed".

place.title: Heart of Gielinor
place.summary: The Heart of Gielinor is a mid-to-high combat area. As with the original God Wars Dungeon, the player must obtain killcount to access each general's chambers, obtained by killing a certain number of soldiers of the respective faction. The only exception to this is Telos, who does not need any killcount (though the player needs to kill the generals of the other factions first).
place.teleport:
• The Heart teleport
• Boss portal
• Combat portal

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
• Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
• Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.
• The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
• Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
• Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
• Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
• Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
• Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
• Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
• Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
• Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
• Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
• Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
• Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros

Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.

Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

place.title: Melzar's Maze
place.summary: To enter the building, players must obtain the maze key from the guildmaster of the Champions' Guild during Dragon Slayer. The key can alternatively be obtained from the shop in the Legends' Guild. Once inside the building, players must go through mazes on each floor and in the basement. However, to proceed to the next floor, players must kill the creature that is holding the key to one of the many doors on the floor.

ml.text: Skeletons in Sinkholes can use any of the three different attack styles. They can only be found in the Abandoned, Occult, and Warped floors, and, with the minor exception of the mage, they are weak to all forms of attack, particularly crush attacks.

place.title: Sinkholes
place.summary: Sinkholes are a Distraction and Diversion involving Dungeoneering, which is for members only. They take place outside Daemonheim at 30 minutes past every hour, in resource dungeons that were once used by Bilrach as storage rooms - these are scattered across Gielinor and the Gorajo have since found them. Their name is derived from a dangerous creature native to the Gorajo realm.

Their name is derived from a dangerous creature native to the Gorajo realm.

place.title: Lair of Tarn Razorlor (dungeon)
place.summary: It is the main base of operations for insane Tarn Razorlor the human necromancer and his undead minions. He had travelled to the area seeking a way to gain more control over the undead, and by enchanting the salve shards found in the nearby mine and making a pendant from it, he was able to do so.
place.teleport: Ring of slaying

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The entrance to Tarn's Lair is at the northern end of the ground level of the Abandoned Mine.
• The fastest way to reach the end of Tarn's Lair is with a ring of slaying, which can be purchased from a Slayer Master or crafted by the player. This teleport allows the player to skip the entire dungeon.
• Drakan's medallion will teleport players to Burgh de Rott, where a shortcut over a fence to the west leads to the mine.
• Taking the shortcut under the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis and travelling on the swamp boat brings players close to Mort'ton. This shortcut is unlocked as a reward from the Burgh De Rott Ramble minigame.

leagueRegion: Wilderness

The Chaos Tunnels are a large dungeon network located in low-level Wilderness, north of Edgeville. It is in a members-only region. It does not require any quests to be accessed. If players attempt to exit the Chaos Tunnels while opted into PvP, they will receive a warning prompt about it before they can continue.

• Dungeoneering Cape
• Dungeoneering master cape
• Hoardstalker ring

getting_there.heading: Entrances
getting_there.text:
There are five rifts that allow entrance to the Chaos Tunnels. These are located:
• North of the Monastery of Saradomin in level 4 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with gargoyles.
• East of the Mage of Zamorak in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with Giant Rock Crabs.
• North of the Grand Exchange in level 7 Wilderness; rift enters a cave with shadow spiders and crypt spiders.
• North of the bridge between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange in level 9 wilderness; enters a cave with moss giants.
• North of the Grand Exchange beacon in level 9 wilderness; rift enters a cave with cave bugs.

During the quest What Lies Below, a safe route into the Chaos Tunnels is uncovered. Entering the statue south-west of the Fort Forinthry leads into the Tunnel of Chaos. From there, the nearest portal to the entrance, towards the north-west, can be used to teleport in to the south-east corner of the Chaos tunnels, a chamber containing giant ant soldiers.

place.title: Abandoned Mine
place.summary: The mine has six levels. It has many ore veins, which yield mithril, coal, luminite, drakolith, and phasmatite in addition to the crystal mine. In the quest, you cut a piece of crystal to make a salve amulet, and you can do so again any time after the quest.
place.teleport:
• Drakan's medallion
• Games necklace

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.

getting_there.heading: Entrance
getting_there.text:
Map:Abandoned Mine surface 
The mine can be approached from the Mort Myre Swamp to the north. Level 61 feral vampyres infest this path. Follow the mine cart tracks to find the main entrance. Most mine carts can simply be walked around, although one cart near the entrance itself must be climbed over. There are also two cart tunnels near the River Salve, where part of the mine cart tracks temporarily leave the mine. All three of these entrances go to level 1.

There is also a set of stairs to the level 2 of the mine. However, both doors to this room are locked and require the crystal mine key to be unlocked. The player acquires this key during the Haunted Mine quest.

For those who have aided Burgh de Rott in the quest In Aid of the Myreque, a new path opens to the east. Jumping over the low fence (25 Agility required) will bring the player near the mine. Just run west a little and then choose your entrance.

getting_there.heading: Accessing the crystal mine
getting_there.text:
Quick-access (pictured right): This only applies if players have completed the Morytania hard tasks and the Haunted Mine quest.
• Enter the mine via the main entrance (climb the cart and through the tunnel) and select Crawl-through option on the tunnel at the cart immediately south.

Players who have not completed the hard Morytania achievements and Haunted Mine quest must follow the steps below to obtain the glowing fungus to gain access.

To get to point L on level 4 from the surface (and move a glowing fungus by mine cart):
# Surface: Enter the main entrance.
# Level 1: Go 1 - 3 - 4; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 4 - 6; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 6 - 12; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 12 - J (get fungus) - central K (put fungus in cart) - L. Also go M and N as necessary to set switches correctly. Push 'Start' at L.

To get to point 10 on level 4 from point L (to get the glowing fungus after moving it):
# Level 4: Go L - 12; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 12 - 6; climb up.
# Level 2: Go 6 - 4; climb up.
# Level 1: Go 4 - 3 - 2; climb down.
# Level 2: Go 2 - 7; climb down.
# Level 3: Go 7 - 10; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 10 - K (search cart for fungus).

To get to point 13 on level 5 from point K on level 4 (to get to the mine/collect key):

#Level 4: Go K - 10; climb up.
# Level 3: Go 10 - 9; climb down.
# Level 4: Go 9 - 13; take lift down to level 5.

To get a new crystal-mine key (skip to next group if you have the key):

# Level 5: Go 14; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 14 - T (take innocent-looking key; turns into crystal-mine key, can be added to the key ring).
#Level 6: Go 14; climb up to get back to level 5.

To get to the crystal mine (with the crystal-mine key):
# Level 5: Go 15; climb down.
# Level 6: Go 15 - U (unlock door with key) - Y (crystal mine).

ml.name: Temple Trekking
ml.text: Skeletons may be encountered during Temple Trekking, in the graveyard event. They can be killed normally, or destroyed by unleashing the tomb in the centre of the area. The tomb can only be unleashed twice.

place.title: Temple Trekking
place.summary: Temple Trekking is a minigame in which players must escort victims of vampyre rule from Burgh de Rott through Morytania to Paterdomus, which requires completion of the In Aid of the Myreque quest. On the way, the player must pass through Morytania's many dangers and obstacles, protecting the accompanying traveller until they reach the temple. The player must find a way across bogs and rivers and fight dangerous packs of monsters lurking in Morytania, some unique to this minigame.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Temple Trekking starts at the town of Burgh de Rott by the northern gate. Start the minigame by reading the noticeboard nearby.

Burgh de Rott Ramble starts on the east side of the River Salve just outside Paterdomus. A player can start on either side.

There are several ways to reach Canifis or Burgh de Rott quickly where the minigame may be started. Some of these include:
• Drakan's medallion teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
• Games necklace teleport to Burgh de Rott (requires completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale). 
• Kharyrll Teleport (requires completion of Desert Treasure and 66 Magic).
• Fairy ring code CKS (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest and getting permission from the Fairy Godfather and at least a dramen staff if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and Lunar Diplomacy are not completed).
• Teleport to Canifis via the Canifis lodestone and enter the long cave through the trapdoor behind the pub for exit near the rowboat to Mort'ton.
• Teleport to the Slayer Tower just north of Canifis using a slayer ring.

ml.name: Graveyard (Mort Myre Swamp)
ml.text: Skeletons may be encountered during Temple Trekking, in the graveyard event. They can be killed normally, or destroyed by unleashing the tomb in the centre of the area. The tomb can only be unleashed twice.

place.title: Graveyard (Mort Myre Swamp)
place.summary: This graveyard mainly features in Desert Treasure quest. The player must fight the vampyre Dessous in order to obtain the blood diamond during the quest. On the way there, the player might encounter several ghasts and some vampyres, so it would be wise to bring along some druid pouches or risk having your food destroyed. The graveyard currently has no uses outside the quest. It can be seen from atop the walls around Castle Drakan.

getting_there.heading: Getting there

• Using fairy ring ALQ to Haunted Woods and running south.
• Using the Canifis lodestone or Kharyrll Teleport and running south-east through the swamps.

place.title: Ullek
place.summary: The area of Ullek is often called the Ruins of Ullek, particularly the plateau with the cliffs and buttes. The swamp area is often called the Swamps of Ullek. Under the plateau is a dungeon, which the High Priest of Scabaras refers to as the Scabarites' hive, and the tomb of Catolax.

getting_there.heading: Location
getting_there.text:
The Ullek area in the south-eastern region of the Kharidian Desert. The approaches to the Ullek area plus Ullek plateau and the coastal area east of the swamp suffer from desert heat, so players are advised to bring water sources.

The area can be entered by travelling east from Sophanem and entering the swamp. The plateau can be reached by climbing up from the swamp, with the player first coming to an archaeologists' camp and then the monster-infested areas.

A shortcut allows access between the plateau and the Agility Pyramid area. However, the shortcut must first be set up, from the plateau, before it can be used. To do so, the player uses a rope on an overhanging rock at the westernmost part of the plateau just west of the archaeologists. The rope will permanently remain there as the shortcut. The shortcut requires 40 Agility.

It is recommended that the player bring a rope and set up the shortcut while doing Dealing with Scabaras, to save time later. Players should be aware that aggressive mummies infest the area around the shortcut on the plateau and should take precautions.

ml.name: Uncharted Isles
ml.text: The skeleton is an attackable NPC that can be found randomly on Uncharted Isles. They may be killed for combat experience and chimes. While not aggressive, they are accurate and can hit hard if players are unprepared for combat. The skeletons are usually found in small groups making it very dangerous to use area-of-effect attacks or abilities against them.

place.title: Uncharted Isles
place.summary: The Uncharted Isles are a procedurally generated island exploration system that offers member players the ability to discover new, unmapped islands in The Arc region. The islands are high-level skilling destinations for Fishing, Woodcutting, Divination, Farming, Hunter and Mining. Each new island has effectively randomly generated hotspots and points of interest. There is no guarantee that any given island will have a specific resource present.

place.title: Waterfall Dungeon
place.summary: During the Waterfall Quest the dungeon is accessed in search of the Chalice of Eternity, containing the treasure of the elven king Baxtorian. During the Roving Elves quest the dungeon must be entered again to consecrate the resting place of queen Glarial. During The Light Within it is discovered that Baxtorian changed himself into a crystal statue and that the statue of Glarial, his wife, contained the Seren shard of integrity.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
The dungeon is in northern Kandarin, and is entered through an outcrop on the face of the Baxtorian Falls. To enter the dungeon the player must have Glarial's amulet and a rope. Go through Almera's house near the falls and out the back gate, use the log raft there to float to an island in the river. From there, get to the next island by using the rope on the rock there. On the second island, use the rope on the dead tree and lower yourself to the ledge on the falls. With Glarial's amulet equipped or in your inventory, enter the dungeon.

The quickest teleport to the area is by teleporting with the games necklace or lunar spell Barbarian Teleport to the Barbarian Outpost, which is directly to the north of Almera's house. Another option, requiring the completion of The Grand Tree and 37 Agility, is to take the Spirit Tree to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and go north, northeast past the Grand Tree, down the tree shortcut and past the lake. Alternatively the player can run north-west from the Ardougne lodestone, past the Fishing Guild and up the fenced mountain path to Almera's house.

Player can also use the fairy ring code BJQ to enter the Ancient Caverns and use the log there to travel to the foot of the falls, close to Almera's house.

The Dungeoneering cape can teleport the user directly to the entrance of the Baxtorian Falls resource dungeon, found in the centre-north room of the dungeon.

Players with 24 Construction may build a rope rack, providing unlimited coils of rope, next to the raft that leads to the Waterfall Dungeon. This requires a saw and hammer (tool-belt tools will suffice), five coils of rope and three oak planks. Alternatively, if the player has allocated 50 points into the pet track at May's Quest Caravan, Lorehound pet can be summoned, providing a free rope.

Note: Do not attempt to swim across or climb down the tree without a rope, as this will fail and you will be washed quite a way down the river and dealt some damage. This also applies when attempting to enter the cavern without having the amulet (not required to wear).

A barrel is located next to the dungeon's entrance, allowing the players to leave the area, leaving them near Gerald, in the same spot as being washed out, but without taking damage. It was originally necessary if the players did not have access to any means of teleporting out, however due to the large number of currently available teleport options this method of leaving dungeon is largely obsolete.

place.title: Ancient Cavern
place.summary: The cavern can only be accessed after the player has completed the first part of Barbarian Firemaking, requiring level 35 Firemaking. After that, the player must ask Otto about making pyre ships, and then will be granted access to the dungeon in order to fulfil the objectives required to make them.

getting_there.heading: Location and getting there
getting_there.text:
The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)

Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
• A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
• A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
• Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
• A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
• A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
• Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake.

Three teleports can be used to directly enter the dungeon:
• Fairy ring code BJQ, which will teleport near the north-western most waterfiends, once it is repaired as described earlier.
• The ferocious ring, which is a drop from the creatures in Kuradal's Dungeon, can teleport the player to Kuradal (Note: you can only attack the monsters in the dungeon if they are your current Slayer assignment assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea.)
• The Slayer cape can be used to teleport the player to Kuradal.

pics: Brine Rat Cavern — wiki map (Brine rat caverns), red dots = spawns

place.title: Brine Rat Cavern
place.summary: The Brine Rat Cavern is a series of caverns which feature heavily in Olaf's Quest, and cannot be accessed beforehand. It can be entered after starting the quest by digging deep snow south of the windswept tree. The entrance is located on a plateau east of Olaf Hradson and southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area. After digging the deep snow, the player will be stunned for a few seconds and emerge in the southwestern section of the cavern.
place.location: Southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text: The Brine Rat Cavern is in the north-eastern region of the Fremennik Province. There are multiple ways to travel to the cavern. One of the quickest ways is to use the fairy ring, code DKS. Alternatively, a player may use the Fremennik Province lodestone and run northeast. Mask or helm of the Frozen Wyrm twice a day to teleport into the Ice strykewyrm cave. From there, exit the cave and you will emerge close to the windswept tree.

ml.requirements: Partial completion of AchievementIcon | Barbarian Firemaking

place.title: Ancient Cavern
place.summary: The cavern can only be accessed after the player has completed the first part of Barbarian Firemaking, requiring level 35 Firemaking. After that, the player must ask Otto about making pyre ships, and then will be granted access to the dungeon in order to fulfil the objectives required to make them.

getting_there.heading: Location and getting there
getting_there.text:
The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)

Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
• A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
• A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
• Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
• A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
• A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
• Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake.

Three teleports can be used to directly enter the dungeon:
• Fairy ring code BJQ, which will teleport near the north-western most waterfiends, once it is repaired as described earlier.
• The ferocious ring, which is a drop from the creatures in Kuradal's Dungeon, can teleport the player to Kuradal (Note: you can only attack the monsters in the dungeon if they are your current Slayer assignment assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea.)
• The Slayer cape can be used to teleport the player to Kuradal.

Players are not required to kill the warlock to complete the quest; after a while it will simply disappear.

• Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone and go west through Al Kharid jetty.

place.title: Uncharted Isles
place.summary: The Uncharted Isles are a procedurally generated island exploration system that offers member players the ability to discover new, unmapped islands in The Arc region. The islands are high-level skilling destinations for Fishing, Woodcutting, Divination, Farming, Hunter and Mining. Each new island has effectively randomly generated hotspots and points of interest. There is no guarantee that any given island will have a specific resource present.

place.title: Ripper Demon cave
place.summary: Zarosian cultist Jebediah Omnis deceived a mining company into opening up the caves under the guise of a simple paid job. Jebediah suspected that the caves were the final resting place of the Ripper Demon that was killed by St. Elspeth, and sent the miners to both unearth the caves and trap them within so that they could serve as hosts for the freshly resurrected Chthonian parasites.

• Teleport to desert strykewyrms with a Mask of the Yellow Wyrm/Helm of the Parched Wyrm, then run west to the shortcut.
• From Al Kharid lodestone, head out of the east exit of the city, and use the shortcut to get to the entrance.

ml.name: South of the Mage Arena
pics: South of the Mage Arena — wiki map (RuneScape Surface), red dots = spawns

place.title: Mage Arena
place.summary: The Mage Arena is a minigame for members in which the player must travel to the Mage Arena in the deep Wilderness and fight Kolodion, the master of battle magic. Fighting in the arena requires level 60 Magic (temporary skill boost do not work), and the ability to kill increasingly difficult forms of Kolodion using only magic. It is also helpful to have 37+ Prayer, so players can use Protect from Magic. While the minigame is members only, the area, including bank and rune shop, is accessible to free-to-play players.
place.location: North of Lava Maze, West of Deserted Keep

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Pull the Wilderness teleport lever in Ardougne or Edgeville, slash through the web to the north and run west to the arena.
• Use a Wilderness sword 4 to teleport to the Wilderness Agility Course, then run north-east.
• Use a portable obelisk, obelisk shard or Ghorrock Teleport (or tablet) to teleport to level 44 Wilderness, run north past the gate and then north-east.
• Use a Slayer cape to teleport to Mandrith, then run east.

To go into the Mage Arena bank, enter the building just north-west of the arena, slash the two webs and pull the lever.

pics: West of the Demonic Ruins, south of the Scorpion Pit — wiki map (RuneScape Surface), red dots = spawns

place.title: Demonic Ruins
place.summary: The Demonic Ruins are the remains of Annakarl, located deep in the Wilderness. The Ruins are inhabited by greater demons and several burnt bone spawns. In members' worlds, Kal'gerion demons and a lone blood rune spawn are present. A large horde of Ripper Demons are also present west of the ruins, and to the east a large number of Greater demon berserkers and Greater demon ash lords.
place.teleport: Annakarl Teleport

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• The fastest way to get here is to use the Annakarl Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook.
• Use an Obelisk (Wilderness) to teleport to the obelisk located near the Rogues' Castle in level 50 Wilderness, then run south east through the gate and continue west. Those with a Wilderness sword 3 or better may choose to be teleported to this obelisk directly. Otherwise, teleports are random and it may take several tries to reach this specific obelisk.
• An alternative is to teleport using a boss portal or the chest found at any of the elite dungeon locations to the Dragonkin Laboratory and then walk out from there, this also provides quick banking in a safe area by Edward, but this area cannot be re-entered if in combat.

ml.name: Lava Maze
pics: Lava Maze — wiki map (RuneScape Surface), red dots = spawns

place.title: Lava Maze
place.summary: The Lava Maze is a maze located deep in the Wilderness, around level 40-45. In the entrance and partway through the maze, there are webs that must be cut with a slash weapon or a knife. It was previously possible for players to be trapped inside the maze if they did not have a slash weapon to cut webs, but having the tool belt with a knife will always allow you to cut through webs, even without a slash weapon or knife in your inventory.
place.teleport:
• Ancient obelisks 
 (Lvl 44, 35, or 27)
• Canoe
• Lava titan

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Three Wilderness obelisks provide a fairly fast way to reach the maze:
• The obelisk in level 44 Wilderness is the closest, from there run a short distance to the southeast.
• The obelisk in level 35 Wilderness is a bit further, the maze entrance is towards the northwest.
• The obelisk in level 27 Wilderness is the furthest but still practical, run a little distance to the north.

Players can also teleport to the Lava Maze by way of a lava titan's special ability.

Players can also ride a canoe to the Wilderness canoe landing, arriving near the level 35 Wilderness Obelisk.

A Wilderness sword 1 or higher can teleport players to the Wilderness herb patch, then walk west to the Lava Maze.

From the Wilderness Crater lodestone, players should run west then north, around the edge of the Wilderness Crater and up to the Lava Maze.

ml.name: Lava Maze Dungeon
pics: Lava Maze Dungeon — wiki map (Lava Maze Dungeon), red dots = spawns

place.title: Lava Maze Dungeon
place.summary: The dungeon is split in two areas. The main western area, accessible only by members, is reached through the eastern entrance in the middle of the Lava Maze and contains several monsters. The smaller eastern area of the dungeon, accessible by free players, is reached through the western entrance found west of the maze, in a metal-fenced area, and contains Poison spiders and the lever to enter the King Black Dragon Lair.

ml.name: Guthix's Cave
ml.text: Sliske appears as an aspect of himself during Desperate Times when the player is sent inside the Needle. A total of five Sliskes will appear around the intertwined platform that appears to be identical to Guthix's Cave. Each one will drop a broken shard of Sliske's mask, which are needed to create Sliske's mask. As each one appears, there will be voice-acted dialogue between Sliske and Guthix in how Guthix tells Sliske of what his fate is and how Guthix must die by Sliske's hands alone.

place.title: Guthixian ruins
place.summary: The upper floor contains a monument to Guthix, attended by the Guthixian High Druid, a druid, and a druidess. Chronicle fragments and elder chronicles can be deposited at the monument for Divination experience. Offering 100 chronicle fragments at the monument unlocks the TitleAnchor | of Guthix title. Offering 100 elder chronicles at the monument unlocks the You're Not My Real Mah achievement.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Use the "Guthix's shrine" teleport on the Sixth-Age circuit or the modified diviner's headwear. 
• Use the fairy ring BLR or cape of legends to the Legends' Guild and running west.
• The combat bracelet can teleport the player to the Ranging Guild, north of the ruins.
• The master archaeologist's outfit can teleport to the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site, north-west of the ruins.
• Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone and run east.

Tumeken's Demise
members: No
map: Map | x=3267 | y=2946 | height=400 | zoom=-1 
leagueRegion: Desert

The Kharidian Desert is an expansive region located south of the nations of Misthalin and Morytania. It spans from the city of Al Kharid in the north to Menaphos and Sophanem in the south. Al Kharid is accessible by all players alike, but the desert south of the Shantay Pass is restricted to members only. In addition, the desert becomes a dangerous region south of the pass, requiring players to carry waterskins or other water sources, lest they suffer the effects of desert heat.

getting_there.heading: Transportation
getting_there.text:
The main form of transportation in the desert is by Magic carpet. They can take the player to a variety of places in the desert, such as: 

# Al Kharid (south of Shantay Pass)
# North Pollnivneach
# South Pollnivneach
# Nardah
# Bedabin Camp
# Uzer (requires The Golem)
# Monkey colony (requires Do No Evil)
# Menaphos (requires Icthlarin's Little Helper)
# Sophanem (requires Icthlarin's Little Helper)

The normal cost of such travel is roughly 200 coins. However, doing the Rogue Trader activity or wearing the activated ring of Charos will decrease the price to 100 coins, and combining them both lowers it to 75 coins.

There are also several fairy rings located in the desert.

Wearing armour of any kind is not advisable, as due to its metallic nature the player will overheat faster and thus use up their supply of water quicker.

place.title: Freneskae
place.summary: Once considered a "perfect" world, Freneskae is now a dark wasteland. Its toxic atmosphere is riddled with constant lightning storms, volcanic eruptions and lava flows near its surface of bare rock. Its native life struggles to survive in the harsh climate, and as a result it is a world of constant warfare. In addition to the Mahjarrat, Freneskae was home to the Mahserrat, Mahkorat, and the Chelon-Mah, and is the only world on which muspah and nihil may be found.
place.teleport: World Gate

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Freneskae may be accessed after starting Fate of the Gods, by means of the World Gate, located north of the Arandar and south of the Eagles' Peak. Fate of the Gods takes place almost entirely on Freneskae, and after the quest is completed, Freneskae remains open for exploration. To access Freneskae through the world gate, it must be dialled to . 

The world gate itself may be reached by:
• Sixth-Age circuit teleport to World Gate (option 2).
• Quest Cape or master quest cape teleport to World Gate (option 0).
• Eagles' Peak lodestone and run south.
• Traveller's necklace teleport to The outpost (option 2) and run west.

place.title: The Zamorakian Undercity
place.summary: While it is considered an Elite Dungeon (with its own luck charms and ability to teleport to the other Elite Dungeons) it is noticeably different compared to the previous three; the health of enemies scales to the party size (and are also more dangerous) and its luck charm costs slightly more and cannot be converted. It also possesses an enrage system that goes up in intervals of 100% past 4,000% enrage, and the enemies' strengths, types, and quantities begin to change as it increases, capping at 60,000%. Players are free to choose their enrage from 0 to 4,000%. Clearing the undercity increases the rewards obtained from Zamorak.

• The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.

• Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
• Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.

• Teleport to Earth altar, or using Fort Forinthry Teleport to the north-west of the ancient door.
• Ride the balloon to Varrock to the north-west of the ancient door.
• Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the treasure chest. Use the teleport on the chest and select The Zamorakian Undercity (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).
• Use the teleport on the treasure chest outside Temple of Aminishi, The Shadow Reef, or the Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).

place.title: Yu'biusk
place.summary: At some point, Yu'biusk was discovered by the god Bandos, who, after seeing the people of the world as savages, decided to give them civilisation as he knew it, and declare the world as his. During the God Wars, Bandos brought the various Yu'biuskian races to Gielinor to fight for and bring glory to his name. Following Bandos' banishment from Gielinor he took his anger out on the Yu'biuskian tribes. Some of these tribes he would manipulate and deceive while others just took advantage of weakened tribes and attacked them. Eventually this led to the construction of fire-raining weapons - weapons the likes no other world has seen according to Bandos. These weapons were what eventually tore Yu'biusk asunder and made it what it is today.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
There are many ways to travel to, from, and within Karamja.

Ship

A popular way to travel for free players is by ship from Port Sarim by talking to the men in front of the ship (first ship you come across heading east from the Port Sarim Lodestone), which costs 30gp for the trip. This can be reduced to 15gp, if you're a member, by completing the easy Karamja achievements, and completely free by using the Ring of charos(a). Another ship route is available from the Ardougne Docks to Brimhaven. Players who wish to travel by boat will have their inventories searched by customs officers, as the law prohibits individuals from carrying rum off the island. Those who wish to circumvent this and smuggle rum to the mainland may find it helpful to check the guide for the Pirate's Treasure quest, where the player must smuggle Karamja rum.

The Wizards' Tower is a famous Saradominist institute of magic and runecrafting in Misthalin. The immense tower is located on a small island south of Draynor Village, connected to the mainland by an exquisite bridge.  The tower is associated with many other wizards outside the tower as well as the Wizards' Guild of Yanille, with which it has a sort of rivalry. The Wizards' Tower has two of the only known portals to the Runespan realm, home of the Runecrafting Guild. The current Wizards' Tower is sometimes known as the Second Wizards' Tower, as the First Wizards' Tower was burnt to the ground due to a magical explosion in the year 70 of the Fifth Age.

The Wizards' Tower is a famous Saradominist institute of magic and runecrafting in Misthalin. The immense tower is located on a small island south of Draynor Village, connected to the mainland by an exquisite bridge.  The tower is associated with many other wizards outside the tower as well as the Wizards' Guild of Yanille, with which it has a sort of rivalry. The Wizards' Tower has two of the only known portals to the Runespan realm, home of the Runecrafting Guild. The current Wizards' Tower is sometimes known as the Second Wizards' Tower, as the First Wizards' Tower was burnt to the ground due to a magical explosion in the year 70 of the Fifth Age.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Canifis may be accessed after completing the Priest in Peril quest or defeating the ghoul and passing through the holy barrier in the basement of Paterdomus for the first time. After doing so, players may travel to Canifis through any of the following methods:
• Canifis lodestone just north-east of Canifis.
• The Ancient Magicks spell Kharyrll Teleport.
• Focussing one of the portals in the Portal Chamber of their house to Canifis (Kharyrll).
• Fairy Ring code CKS.
• After completing Ghosts Ahoy, using the ectophial to teleport to the ectofuntus. This gives a moderately-close teleport that is free and unlimited. If lost, one may obtain a replacement from Velorina.
• After completing In Search of the Myreque, taking the shortcut to Mort'ton down a ladder south of the Hair of the Dog inn that leads to the north-east part of the Mort Myre Swamp.
• Taking the Swamp Boat between The Hollows and Mort'ton. This cuts out around half the distance.
• Using a ring of slaying to teleport to the Slayer Tower just north-west of Canifis.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Before repairing fairy ring BJS (requires five bittercap mushrooms), players can get to the Lost Grove by inspecting the standstone south of the Poison Waste, west of the incandescent wisp colony. Methods for getting there include:
• Use the incandescent wisp colony teleport on the elder divination outfit or the Solak boss portal. 
• Create a group for fighting Solak, Guardian of the Grove and teleport there alone (the minimum player requirement is only one).
• Use the fairy ring code BKP or a ring of duelling to go south of Castle Wars and run west.
• Use the Northern Lost Grove Teleport or its tablet.
• The magic golem head can teleport to the Lost Grove (near the vinecrawlers) if a Shooting Star lands there, once per day. Oddly, it can return the error message "You do not meet the requirements to teleport to where the shooting star has landed." despite there being no requirements to enter The Lost Grove, and the magic golem head may still be able to teleport to there regardless.

Once arriving at the Lost Grove, players may use five bittercap mushrooms on the fairy ring near the middle of the island and then use the code BJS to get there even faster in the future.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

ml.name: Daemonheim
ml.text: Soulgazers are Slayer monsters and a type of stalker found in Daemonheim that can only be fought while Dungeoneering. Its combat level is 128 and it requires level 99 Slayer to damage. It attacks all players within reach at once with an accurate, magic based yellow orb attack with a max hit of 368. Magic damage can be reduced by using Protect from Magic or Deflect Magic. The much sought after hexhunter bow is only obtainable as a drop from a soulgazer.
pics: Moia, daughter of Lucien and a half-human, delved into Daemonheim in order to find and investigate Bilrach.

place.title: Daemonheim
place.summary: Most of Daemonheim's history is told through the Chronicles of Bilrach, which are discovered as a player trains the Dungeoneering skill. Currently, an army of Fremenniks have set up a campsite in the area to prepare for their next expedition into the enormous labyrinths below the castle.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
• Teleporting there by using the ring of kinship, which is received from the Dungeoneering tutor.
• Teleporting to Daemonheim Dig Site by using the dig sites map located in the Archaeology Guild (with level 73 Archaeology after rescuing Skaldrun).
• Dungeoneering portal in the Tower of Voices in Prifddinas.
• Taking the Fremennik ship from south-western Taverley by talking to Bryll Thoksdottir at the docks. While the Fremennik shipmaster at Daemonheim can take players back to Taverley, be careful not to click the third option or on the Fremennik ship behind him, as they will take players to the Shadow Reef, a high-level combat zone without any warning about its dangers.
• Walking through the Wilderness to the east.
• War's Retreat Teleport then enter the Shadow Reef boss portal.

Four types of abyssal demons roam around the obelisk and the north entrance of Forinthry Dungeon.

place.title: Wilderness
place.summary: The Wilderness is infamous for being arguably the most perilous area in all of Gielinor. The terrain is mostly charred and barren, gradually progressing from sparsely wooded areas to volcanic terrain to a frozen wasteland as the player travels north. The Wilderness is inhabited by many different foes that generally become stronger in the deeper areas, including thugs, zombies, grizzly bears, and hill giants, as well as more powerful creatures such as demons, dragons, dark beasts, and glacors. Most of the monsters in the Wilderness are permanently aggressive, can attack in groups and follow players quite far from their habitat, so caution should be taken when running past groups of dangerous monsters. The main appeal of the Wilderness is that it offers many lucrative combat and skilling opportunities, albeit with greater risk of death.

place.title: Underground Pass (dungeon)
place.summary: The Dark Lord, a part of Seren trapped by the Temple of Light kept whispering to people who went into the pass, and corrupted anyone who entered.

getting_there.heading: Travelling through
getting_there.text:
The following only contains information on how to get through the pass after the quest is done.

The player will not be able to enter Iban's Temple and the elven lands until the player has spoken to King Lathas at the start of Regicide. The player's quest journal will mention about assassinating his brother if they have talked to him.

Travelling through Underground path

To go through the path, it is recommended to have a high Agility level. A Thieving level of 50 is another advantage.

These items are needed:
• A rope (bring more if the Agility level is low)
• A shortbow (chargebow will not work)
• A few of bronze, iron, steel, mithril, adamant, rune, dragon, or dark arrows (bring a few extras should you do so; no advantage in type)
• Food to survive traps and monsters

Part 1

Checklist | * Enter the pass through the cave entrance in West Ardougne.
• Simply walk around the swamp and do not attempt to cross the bubbles in the cave.
• Talk to Koftik, and he will give you a damp cloth.
• Use it on an arrow to change it to a fire arrow.
• Light this arrow. It is possible to miss arrows in the next steps, so you may need to make more. Only make one at a time because you can not light these arrows if there is more than one in your inventory.
• Go to the north.
• Equip the bow and fire at the guide rope with the lit fire arrow, and you will automatically cross the bridge.
• Once you have crossed the bridge, you may be attacked by level 42 blessed spiders if you are under level #expr:42*2 Combat. Stay away from the small rooms to the north and south to avoid them.
• Now, go to the little chamber to the north and pick up a plank.
• Continue going south, then east.
• Use a rope on an old spike on the ground on your side next to the north gap. It is possible to fail this part and lose your rope, so bringing multiple ropes is a good precaution. If you do fall, you will have to navigate a rock maze to get out. You will end up at the beginning of the pass, and you'll have to start with firing at the guide rope again. The old spike is very small and slightly below ground level. It may be necessary to point your camera west and zoom very far in to see it.
• Continue following the path and climb over two rockslides.
• You will come to a grid of spike traps. For each person the path to cross these is different, so it is suggested that once you find your path, you write it down somewhere. You could already have figured out which path is safe for you while doing the quest Underground Pass. The area prevents you from using abilities like Surge.

Pathmap | 5 | 5 | id=Underground Pass 
Checklist | * Once past the spike traps, pull the lever to the south and the portcullis will rise. Do not take the obstacle pipe because it's only one-way and you will have to redo guide rope obstacle.
• After passing the gate, you should be in a room full of zombies. Head west past the furnace.
• Continue going west, and as you run past the spear wall traps, you might take some damage. If you have a good Thieving level you can try to disable them by searching the odd markings on the wall. You may take multiple triple-digit damage per trap if you try to run past without disabling them. Area prevents you from using abilities like Surge so it is best to disarm the traps. Search on the odd markings on the wall, then run two tiles ahead of you. With run active, your character will run past the wall trap without activating it. You'll only take damage if you run across them all at once.
• Next, climb down the well.

Part 2

Checklist | * Head west towards the cages of slaves.
• Enter the south-east cage and dig up the mud. This will take you to the back of the cage.
• Follow the path and cross the ledge (if you fail, you will reach back to the cell area).
• In the next area you have a couple choices.
• If you have 50 Thieving, you may pick the locks on two cages by following the southward path. Once past the cage, make sure you don't step on the bubbles, or you'll have to start back at the beginning.
• Otherwise, head onto the wooden bridges, balancing over the narrow parts. Take the right path, left, then finally, the left again. The higher your Agility level, the less your chance of failing it.
• Whichever path you took, follow the path to the south and squeeze through the pipe.

Part 3

Checklist | * Go past the smashed cage and pass through the tunnel on the north side of the cave.
• Follow the passage until you pass the zombies and see paladins.
• Use the plank found earlier on either one of the flat rock traps to get past.
• Continue forward, open the door, and you will be standing in Iban's lair.

Travelling to the end of Underground Pass in Iban's lair

Checklist | * After entering, head as far south (past the bridges and walkways) as you can. Along the back wall, you'll find stairs.
• Descend the cave stairs (this will take you to "Beneath Iban's Lair" as shown on the world map).
• If you need food, talk to Kamen the dwarf in the southwest corner of the cave. 
• Decline or accept Kamen's brew, but note that it will lower your Agility, potentially heightening your chances of falling into the abyss in the next step. 
• After declining or accepting, Kamen will offer to sell you food for 75 coins. 
• Proceed to the northwest corner until you find cave stairs that can be ascended.
• Ascend the stairs. 
• If at any point you fall during the next steps, these stairs are where you'll go to return to Iban's Lair and try again.
• Heading south, cross the third walkway.
• Jump over the bridge to the first platform.
• From the first platform, go southeast to a second platform.
• From the second platform, take the eastern path over a winding bridge to the third platform. There should be some red-cloaked Disciples of Iban on this platform.
• Proceed south for a bridge jump.
• Take the western path closest to the Temple of Iban stairs.
• Open the temple door.
• Doing so will unlock the Well of Voyage music track. 
• You can talk to Koftik here if you have completed the Underground Pass quest, who will give you some food if you were hurt by the traps.
• Climb-down the well.
• Head west past the glowing obelisks and exit the cave.
